status: Primary-source review; independent peer review and numeric scenario calibration pending

scope_decisions.refinery_candidates: SAPREF redevelopment and Natref outlook; user will provide additional evidence
scope_decisions.secunda_mechanism: Declining gas supply plus MRG diversion may reduce liquid fuels; distinct from improving coal quality/gasifier recovery
scope_decisions.road_corridors: Four road corridors not yet confirmed

findings.fact: CEF describes phased redevelopment: initial terminal/depot/import functionality, then refining at approximately 400,000 bbl/day, with a longer-term 400,000-650,000 bbl/day objective subject to investment and approvals.
findings.interpretation: A terminal/import phase can precede refining; do not replace imports with full refinery output on announcement.
findings.gap: FID, dates, ramp-up, product slate and financing. This release does not establish a 2033 commissioning date.

findings.fact: Sasol's 1 September 2026 update reports a mid-August downstream-unit outage coinciding with another unit's planned shutdown; continuity measures described through end September.
findings.interpretation: Evidence of operating risk, not permanent closure. FY2026 reported production improvement does not remove current outage risk.
findings.gap: Post-September operating status; outage duration, product losses, Prax/ownership and future investment.

findings.fact: Sasol confirms technical feasibility of supplying Secunda MRG externally July 2028-June 2030 as Mozambican gas declines; implementation depends on regulatory approval, customer compatibility and investment decisions.
findings.interpretation: Treat coal/gasifier recovery and feedstock diversion as separate effects. User's liquid-fuel displacement hypothesis is not quantified by this release.
findings.gap: MRG PJ/year, internal gas balance, LNG/other replacement and marginal petrol/diesel output losses; updated approvals.

findings.fact: PetroSA's published tender scope states GTL non-operation since December 2020, terminal adaptation to finished-product imports and proposed liquids-refinery recommissioning without the offshore/HTFT sections.
findings.interpretation: Use 'non-operating since December 2020' rather than confirmed permanent closure. Recommissioning proposal is not committed output.
findings.gap: Publication date, subsequent project approvals, timeline, supply/yields and operating status confirmation.

findings.fact: Government communication sets at least 250 Mt on the Transnet network by 2030; FY2025 Transnet results report 160.1 Mt actual.
findings.interpretation: Network ambition is not all Transnet-operated incremental freight and not all displaced road freight.
findings.gap: Reconcile policy target vintages; corridor/commodity detail and net road-to-rail transfer.
